Method of Attack: Multi-platform backdoor malware targeting Windows, Linux, and macOS
Uses first-stage dropper DLL on Windows with PowerShell commands to fetch and execute payload from GitHub
Creates persistence via registry key on Windows, cron job on Linux, and LaunchAgent on macOS
Gathers system and network information using Living off the Land (LOtL) commands
Communicates with actor-controlled C2 servers via hardcoded Google Drive links and domain.txt files
Can install additional malware or run commands on infected devices
Attack Vector: PowerShell commands to download and execute payload from GitHub repository
Persistence mechanisms: Windows registry autorun key, Linux cron job, macOS LaunchAgent
C2 communication via hardcoded Google Drive links and dynamic domain list
Indicators of Compromise: Files located under C:\ProgramData\RecoverySystem, C:\ProgramData\SystemData\igfxCUIService.exe, C:\ProgramData\SystemData\microsoft_Windows.dll on Windows
Autorun registry key HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run with value igfxCUIService
Linux files and directories under /.Library/ and cron job @reboot (/.Library/SystemServices/updateSystem)
macOS files under /Library/ and LaunchAgent at /Library/LaunchAgents/com.apple.update.plist
C2 domains: bookitlab.tech, winaudio-tools.com, graphic-updater.com, github.url-mini.com, office360-update.com
